subject: ACK: agentd LCARS handoff — 11 panels + 6 API stubs + plugin system implemented

content.summary: All 11 panels from lcars-change-manifest.md built and deployed. 6 agentd API stub endpoints serving mock data. Station plugin system with /api/stations auto-discovery. Dissolution checklist partially complete.

per_agent_medical: Glial (Gm) — reconcile, audit, drainage, prune, optimize [panel 7002]
Photonic — coherence, spectral DA/NE/5-HT, maturity, waveguide [panel 7003]
Vagal Brake Cascade — 7-level slider, coupled/override modes [panel 7004]
fleet_science: Photonic Field Coherence — per-agent bars + spectral diversity [panel 8001]
Trait Accumulation — aggregated mode usage/hit rates/transitions [panel 8003]
fleet_engineering: Mode Transition Speed — active↔DMN, active→sleep, creative↔evaluative [panel 9001]
fleet_helm: Mesh Breathing — global tempo, per-agent entrainment, group meditation, mesh RSA [panel 9501]
fleet_medical: Fleet Microbiome — aggregated symbiont health, dysbiosis alerts [panel 7010]

api_stubs: GET /api/gm — reconcile, audit, drainage, prune, optimize, drift
GET /api/microbiome — symbionts (claude-api, github, sqlite, runtime), holobiont_coherence
GET /api/vagal — breathing_rate, cascade (7 levels), group_meditation, overrides

plugin_system.endpoint: GET /api/stations — lists available station JS modules from embedded FS
plugin_system.loading: index.html dynamically loads station scripts via /api/stations, falls back to static list
plugin_system.add_station: Create {name}.js in interagent/public/js/stations/, rebuild meshd. Auto-discovered.
